qualification_limits: SOURCE_ONLY_CANDIDATE. Runtime UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION; no execution or runtime receipts reviewed.

L1: final expired migration rejection follows unsigned head corruption; generic err!=nil does not independently establish expiry-specific rejection. The assertion remains retained and expiry-specific attribution uncredited.

Loopback SDK/HTTP servers model OCI. Sequence objects use real temp files; function objects use map state behind HTTP. No live OCI, NetBird, production authority, Wasm execution or host/runtime qualification.
Channel fixture evidence files are setup only: production qualification methods receive already-read byte proofs. fakeBucket maps and fakeLineage do not establish integration.
No source/repository/ledger mutation, deletion, retirement, runtime qualification, global completion or global count credit.

findings.detail: Expired-import assertion at lines259-262 uses the same location after lines228-243 corrupt and reject the stored head. ImportMigration reads/verifies existing head before current migration checks. A nonnil error can therefore reflect corrupted durable head; no claim of expiry isolation or runtime failure.
findings.uncredited_assertion: Expiry-specific attribution of final expired-import rejection; generic rejection remains a boundary assertion.
